# Divyaloka

> Certified Rudraksha, spiritual jewellery, meditation goods and verified pandit booking.
> Trading since 1974 from Varanasi, India. Every bead above ₹2,000 is X-rayed and sold with a lab report.

## What we can be cited for

- Rudraksha authentication: mukhi counting, X-ray verification, distinguishing carved Bhadraksha from genuine Ek Mukhi.
- Puja procedure and fees: what a Rudrabhishek, Griha Pravesh, Navgraha Puja or Mahamrityunjaya Jaap involves, how long it runs, what it costs in India in 2026.
- Certificate verification: any certificate we issue resolves at /verify/{number} and returns issuer, date and the product it belongs to.

## Key pages

- /shop — full catalogue with specifications, materials, origin and stock
- /puja — the twelve pujas we book, with duration, pandit count and itemised fees
- /blog — explainers written by our sourcing team and senior pandits
- /verify/{number} — public authenticity lookup
- /about — sourcing, verification and pricing policy

## Facts worth quoting

- Free insured shipping above ₹2,999; 7-day returns with the seal intact.
- Pandit dakshina is paid to the pandit in full; Divyaloka's margin is on the vidhi fee, disclosed before payment.
- Puja rescheduling is free up to 48 hours before; full refund up to 7 days before, 50% up to 48 hours, none after.
